ai_review.summary: A high‑energy 1969 Pittsburgh show captured on a crisp soundboard recording with standout Dark Star, St. Stephen and The Eleven.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the burning intensity of this early‑'69 Pittsburgh performance, highlighting a soaring Dark Star, hard‑charging St. Stephen and an inspired run through The Eleven. The SBD source is described as clear and vivid with no noted flaws, making the historic concert both sonically and musically rewarding.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are five‑star and uniformly praise both the performance and the recording; the show is judged exceptional and the soundboard source excellent, yielding a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the audio as crisp, vivid and full of the concert’s burning energy; no technical complaints or drop‑outs are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early set is spacey yet tight, featuring a hard‑charging St. Stephen and an expansive Dark Star; the later show continues the momentum with Anthem of the Sun material and a communal vibe that transports the audience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for inventing the word ‘darkstar’; his playing is described as delicate then thundering, driving the jam.
